title: Create a GPT-backed blog post generator using Next JS and Editor JS
description: Part 1: Starting with the blog template at https://blog.itsrakesh.co/how-to-set-up-your-own-personal-blog-step-by-step-guide , I would like to add an online editor using EditorJS https://editorjs.io/ (the blog template does not include an editor interface. You can use the steps in the link provided to set up the blog - it's fine to use the free or starter plans for any services it mentions like HyGraph and Cloudinary. I don't need the discussion piece so you can skip the part about Giscus. You can also skip the Google Analytics, Coil, BeyondWords, Ko-Fi, AdSense, or the newsletter. Instead of Netlify I would like this to be deployable to Vercel. Part 2: Next, create a post creator and editor workflow. The editor should start by asking the user to describe the post they want to generate in 2-3 sentences. Take their input and post it to an API route in the same project (I prefer to use fetch for this rather than axios). That API route should take the user's input and call the OpenAI GPT 3 or 4 API using the following prompt: ``` Generate a blog post outline and relevant title based on the following topic: "[USER_PROVIDED_TOPIC]" Format the output in the JSON structure preferred by Editor JS. ``` Return the data back to the client and render it using Editor JS for the user to review in the editor. Add a custom button and plugin (there are general instructions here https://editorjs.io/the-first-plugin/ ) for each of the outline headings to generate the body content for that section of the blog post. This should call an API route in the project, which will then call the OpenAI API with the following prompt: ``` Given a blog post with the following outline: "[Include the outline from the blog post]", generate the content for section [section number] titled [title of the section the user requested]. Format the output in the JSON structure preferred by Editor JS. ``` When the data is returned, insert it in the appropriate section of the blog post. The application should be able to save this post to HyGraph, and once it is saved, the post should be available in the blog itself for viewing. I will provide API keys for any paid services as needed and to offer any guidance needed. Deliverables for this project are a working demo deployed to Vercel and a link to a public repo I can clone.

title: Netty based proxy Refactoring
description: PLEASE DO NOT APPLY TO THIS IF YOU HAVE NOT CONTRIBUTED TO NETTY OPEN SOURCE OR BUILT HIGH-PERFORMANCE NETTY APPLICATIONS Netty Proxy Statement of Work ======================== The safekids.ai HTTP proxy is based on NITM proxy which is an opensource codebase. It was forked predominantly to address core issues with lack of maintenance of the codebase. It is available in limited public view at https://github.com/safekids-ai/http-proxy-java. Safe Kids Proxy is built in JAVA and utilizes NETTY for all relevant protocols. The proxy can operate in both transparent mode or via HTTP proxy mode. Goal 1 (make sure everything works) and improve performance ===== While the proxy is fully functional, extensive tests need to be done to make sure NO functionality is broken on a machine where the proxy runs. This includes windows and mac operating systems and testing multiple browsers and applications on those machines including but not limited to App Stores, Office programs, chat apps like Discord, Slack etc. In addition, the goal is to make this extremely high performing where the user should not notice any degradation in latency and functionality. We need to create multiple test suites to automate this process and make sure nothing in the protocol core is broken. The codebase would need refactoring to make sure it performs exceptionally well. Goal 2 (intercept and replace content and support compression types) ============================================= The second step is to enable the proxy to modify the content of the website. This part has been implemented but needs to be refactored to make it cleaner and high performing. The class is Http2RawInterceptHandler.java under http2 but another similar functionality needs to be created for HTTP1 as well. The class intercepts based on the content type (for e.g. text/html). In this case, it decompressed the content, replaces it with user defined content, compressed it again and send it to the browser. Compression types including gzip, brotli and deflate. In the case of brotli, the brotli DLL which is part of the brotli for java package is considered by anti virus to be a compromised DLL (perhaps because it is not signed). Ideally, we should have a nice implementation that doesn’t cause anti virus issues.

title: Machine learning engineer for NLP embedding models
description: Purpose; A generally repurposable Transformer model, used to create embedding of rich text data such as reviews, biographies and short form content of up to 2gb of training data. There are three components to the model: 1/ Clustering multiple text features into discrete groups 2/ Ability for the model to generate similarity cosine scores for each cluster with a input text (i.e search query) 3/ Infrastructure development to support deployment, scheduling and running of the model if GPUs are required to allow for scalability Scalability and speed are important as we intend to use the model for real-time applications as a result the model needs to run on GPUs and can easily be increased if there is a need for larger training sets. You would be required to write the code, deploy the code on infrastructure that can be run GPUs (we don’t have a preference for the specific cloud service to utilise, recommendations are welcome) Example use cases: For example we want to cluster all the member of linkedin using their bio, job experience and recommendations into groups of similar members. When we add an input of “Professions who are good at dancing and banking” the model can product a ranking of all the clusters ranked by the cosine distance Requirements Transformer model should have a maximum latency of 5 seconds for 20mb of input data. Python as the primary language (either tensorflow or Pytorch) The model should be capable of converting reviews, bios, and other text into cosine similar scores The model should be able to handle input text of varying lengths and format without a maximum limit on the length. The model should be able to produce an embedding for each input text that captures the meaning of the text. The model should be able to handle large amounts of data and easily scalable with additional GPUs using a cloud service The model should be able to produce an embedding with at least 300 dimensions for each input text that captures the meaning of the text. The model should be able to handle a minimum of 100,000 input text and should be able to scale to handle at least 1,000,000 input text. The model should have a minimum accuracy of 90% on a held-out test set of data. The model should be able to handle at least 5 different languages. The model should be able to be trained on a minimum of 50,000 text inputs and fine-tuned on at least 5,000 text inputs. The model should have the ability to update embeddings as more data is fed into the model, with at least once a day.

title: Crypto.com API from Excel Help Needed
description: I am looking to use excel to connect to my crypto.com account using their API: Documentation here https://exchange-docs.crypto.com/exchange/v1/rest-ws/index.html?csharp#websocket. But I am having issues in the first step. I can connect to the API with a public request from excel, but for private requests connected directly to my account at Crypto.com they have a "Digital Signature" procedure. I have set up a sub account at Crypto.com with its own private key and secret key. and I would like a spreadsheet created that can, create the correctly formatted HMAC-SHA256 signature, which they state in their documentations is: The algorithm for generating the HMAC-SHA256 signature is as follows: If "params" exist in the request, sort the request parameter keys in ascending order. Combine all the ordered parameter keys as key + value (no spaces, no delimiters). Let's call this the parameter string Next, do the following: method + id + api_key + parameter string + nonce Use HMAC-SHA256 to hash the above using the API Secret as the cryptographic key Encode the output as a hex string -- this is your Digital Signature ________________________ I only need the spreadsheet to connect to create the signature required to come back with one example of one the API requests, such as :user-balance Once this first step is created I will be able to do the rest. As a result to the right person I dont think this will take very long at all, so $100 seems fair to anyone who is confident they can provide an excel spreadsheet with Macro or function that can hash the signature and request successfully just once.

title: Build Healthcare Website
description: Product Requirement Document: Healthcare Website Overview We are developing a website-based healthcare service that will allow patients to find and book appointments with doctors in their area. The website will provide patients with information about doctors, including ratings, cost, and services offered, as well as the ability to book appointments online. Features The website will have the following features: Doctor Search Patients will be able to search for doctors based on location, specialty, and availability. The search results will display a list of doctors, including their ratings, cost, and services offered. Doctor Profiles Each doctor will have a profile page with their photo, bio, ratings, cost, and services offered. Patients will be able to read reviews from other patients and see a list of appointments available. Appointment Booking Patients will be able to book appointments online, choosing the time and date that works best for them. They will receive a confirmation email and reminder email before the appointment. Doctor Ratings and Reviews Patients will be able to rate and review their doctor after their appointment. This feedback will be used to improve the service and help other patients find the right doctor for their needs. Technical Requirements The website will be built using an existing web builder tool such as Shopify, WordPress, or Wix. The tool will be customized to include the following features: Business Requirements The website will generate revenue through a commission-based model, where a percentage of the doctor's fee will be charged for each appointment booked through the website. The website will also offer premium features to doctors, such as enhanced profiles and priority placement in search results, for a fee. Conclusion Using an existing web builder tool will allow for a faster and more cost-effective development process. With customized features such as the doctor search, profiles, appointment booking, and rating system, the website will provide patients with a convenient and easy-to-use way to find and book appointments with doctors in their area. The addition of web scraping functionality will ensure that the website has a comprehensive database of doctors in the area, providing patients with the most up-to-date information possible. Competitors: https://www.practo.com/ https://www.zocdoc.com/ https://www.solvhealth.com/

description: I’m looking to develop a custom day trading momentum stock scanner.It revolves around immediate volatility of a stock based on multiples of its previous volatility.I want to use ATR% as the main source of calculations for the scanner.I want to be able to scan stocks based on their recent moves being a multiple of their previous ATR%.ATR% = ATR divided by price, in percentage.example: if a stock’s ATR is 4.01 and the stock price is 50.42, it’s ATR% is 7.95%I want to be able to change the timeframe of the scanner. I want to be able to choose the value for Z.That’s for the calculation. There’s also more that I want to include:I also want to be able to set the minimum $ volume traded in the past y candles (for example, minimum 10 million USD volume in the past 10 candles)To do the $ volume we’ll do share volume x share price.I also want to be able to have automatically a “liquidity cap” displayed with each stock that will pop in the scanner. The liquidity cap means 1/10th of the average volume of the past y candles (for example, if the stock traded an average of 1 million USD in each of the last 10 candles, the liquidity cap should show 100K USD)I must be able to choose the liquidity cap range (1/10th, 1/100th, 1/50th, etc).The stock scanner must work with premarket data, live data and post market data. description: Heya!I'm looking for a mangaka to draw a story which I've written.The title of this manga is going to be "Jinrui no Kokoro (The Heart of Humanity)".The general theme of the story is all about humaneness, constantly raising the question of "what constitutes humanity?", therefore I'm exploring ALL nuances of being a human within the story, also the ones that are generally being perceived as "taboos"! I want to show how it is really like to be human, containing all the beautiful things about being human, just as the dark and tragic ones. I'm being very explicit, not hiding any facets, thus I need a mangaka who is very resilient mentally!The story itself is going to be about a young man, who has essentially given up on his life already, standing on the verge of committing suicide, just to find out that he is the chosen one who is supposed to save humanity. On the journey to do so, he'll constantly be faced with how brutal reality is and what cruel things human beings are capable of, being forced into an internal struggle. He was not particularly fond of human beings at the start of his journey in the first place and throughout the story he'll be wondering more and more, if it's the right thing to save humanity or should he rather work along with those who're trying to eradicate it? Already shouldering this heavy burden, he falls in love with a young woman who accompanies him on his journey, who turns out to be an advanced AI robot, just as he starts to see an example in her for how pure human beings can be, further spilling oil into his ongoing questions about if it actually needs human beings. The antagonist of the story is a young woman, the CEO of a giant tech company which is a leading force in AI and cybernetic technology. This company works together with various governments in the world, kidnapping citizens and exchanging them with Ai robots which are 1 to 1 copies of said individuals, so no one even notices that their loved ones are going missing. The overarching plan here is, to exchange all the meaningless individuals in the world with those robots, because those robots obey no matter what, they don't have any needs, so they never become unhappy and they don't waste as many resources as a human being would. title: Update React Web App Integrating OpenAI and Midjourney AI Bots to e-commerce and NFT platforms
description: We are seeking an experienced developer to join our team and assist with updating our react web app. The primary goal of this project is to integrate OpenAI and Midjourney AI Bots into our existing web application. The app will provide users with a range of prompt methodologies for the AI systems, enabling them to generate unique content and upload directly to ecommerce and NFT platforms. DETAILS - With this update, users will have four main prompt methodologies to choose from. These methodologies include single input, list input, theme-based prompts, and photo editing. In the first methodology, users will be able to provide a sentence as input, which will generate a response from the AI system. This approach will include a list of prompts that users can choose from by clicking on them. In the second methodology, users will be able to input multiple lists, and the AI system will cycle through them, creating a combination of inputs and outputs that will generate a large number of images. The third methodology will enable users to input a general theme, which will be used by GPT-3 to provide input options to the user. The user can then select the prompts they want to use and output. The final methodology will allow users to upload photos for editing. The AI system will use DALLE, and the user will also be able to edit the photo based on their input. With DALLE, we will have to make API requests, and with Midjourney, we will need to manage requests to and from their Discord. title: Full Stack Development - Bring my idea to life
description: Overview: We aim to develop a website that hosts editable PDF forms from governments worldwide. The website will cater to users who want to fill out tax, real estate, business, and government forms online, for free. The platform will be an all-in-one solution to enable users to search for specific forms and fill them out online. Our primary goal is to offer a seamless user experience while generating revenue through programmatic ad placement and a subscription-based model. Features: SEO optimized pages for specific forms: The website will have a separate page for each form. Each page will be SEO optimized, so users can easily find the form they need through Google searches. The pages will also be available in the native language of the user. Editable PDF forms: The website will offer editable PDF forms that users can fill out online. Users can save their progress and complete the form at their convenience. Free trial option: We will offer a 7-day free trial for users to access all the forms on the website. After the free trial period, the user will be prompted to sign up for a monthly or yearly membership. User account creation: We will encourage users to sign up for an account by offering the ability to save progress and forms they filled out. Inside their account, users will have a logged-in experience where they can see and manage all their saved documents. Subscription-based model: After the free trial period, users will have to subscribe to a monthly or yearly membership to access all the forms on the website. Monetization: The platform will generate revenue through programmatic ad placement and a subscription-based model. Multiple languages and currencies: The website will host documents in various languages ranging from Tagalog to Romanian. Therefore, the site architecture will need to support multiple countries, languages, currencies, and billing providers. Privacy regulations: The website will adhere to various privacy regulations around the world, such as GDPR, CCPA, etc., to ensure the protection of user data. Security: The website will ensure the security and privacy of user data through encryption and other standard security protocols. Canonical Pages: Some documents get updated each year, so we will need a canonical page (e.g., 1099 Form) that can link to various year's versions (e.g., 2019 1099 form). This feature will provide users with access to different versions of the same document. CMS: The website will be built on top of an easy-to-use CMS, allowing the website owner to create pages by uploading the PDF document and adding associated descriptions and metadata. This feature will allow the website owner to manage and update the website with ease. Conclusion: Our website will offer a convenient and free solution to users who want to fill out various forms online. Our goal is to make the process as seamless as possible while also generating revenue through programmatic ad placement and a subscription-based model. We plan to ensure security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and multi-language/currency support while providing a high-quality user experience. The addition of a logged-in user experience and the canonical page feature will provide users with more control and flexibility in managing their documents. The inclusion of a CMS will make it easy for the website owner to manage and update the website regularly.
